description: Code-behind for StartExam.aspx page handling exam selection, course loading based on user session, and navigation in an online examination system.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for StartExam.aspx page managing exam selection, course list population based on user semester, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; loads course list based on user semester stored in session.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts selected exam (Theory or MCQ) after checking database for available questions.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exam from grid, checks if already taken, and initiates exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exam from grid, checks if already taken, and initiates exam.
